_about: Plain-language meanings for Kuttoe settings. 'source' is load-bearing: 'itch.io' was read off the mod's own page and can be stated as fact; 'inferred' was deduced from the key name, its stored value, and surrounding keys, and must be flagged as inference when reported.
_units: Cooldowns in this framework are stored in SIM-MINUTES even where the mod's page documents them in hours. SpellcasterTweaks.tome_cooldown is documented as 4 hours and stored as 240; teachspell_cooldown is documented as 60 hours and stored as 3600. Settings whose name ends in _days are stored in days, and LongerLastingNails.nail_duration is in minutes (4320 = 72h = 3 days).

SpellcasterTweaks.copypasto_nerf.text: Duplicating items with Copypasto generates Charge scaled to the item's value and rarity, so repeatedly cloning expensive things risks magical overload.

SpellcasterTweaks.dedeathify_nerf.text: Resurrection costs far more Charge (300 per cast), so you need Charge-reducing perks first or the spell overloads you.

SpellcasterTweaks.discharge_drain.text: Using Discharge to dump Charge also drains 15% Energy, so the safety valve has a cost.

SpellcasterTweaks.more_charge_gain.text: All spells and practice build Charge faster, and the Charge Control perk suppresses less of it. Raises the overall risk level of casting.

SpellcasterTweaks.learning_changes.text: Changes how spells are learned: tome searches become more frequent, but Sages teach spells directly less often.

SpellcasterTweaks.tome_cooldown.text: Wait between searches for new spell tomes. Stored in SIM-MINUTES; the mod documents the default as 4 hours, which is 240 here.

SpellcasterTweaks.teachspell_cooldown.text: Wait between asking a Sage to teach a spell. Stored in SIM-MINUTES; documented default is 60 hours, which is 3600 here.

PotionsRework.recipe_overhaul.text: Rewrites every potion recipe so each needs at least three different ingredients, with higher tiers requiring rare materials from specific places. The core of the mod.

PotionsRework.potion_value.text: Prices newly brewed potions by the Spellcaster rank required and ingredient rarity, making brewing worth money.

PotionsRework.better_tooltip.text: Shows a potion's monetary value in its inventory hover tooltip.

PotionsRework.reagent_shop_addon.text: Caster's Alley stocks a wider range of reagents in larger daily quantities, though master-tier ingredients stay rare.

PotionsRework.no_free_samples.text: Learning a master-level recipe no longer hands you free sample potions, closing off unlimited access to powerful elixirs.

PotionsRework.no_immortal_glow.text: Removes the visible glow on Sims with the Immortal trait. Purely cosmetic.

PotionsRework.plentiful_needs_nerf.text: The Potion of Plentiful Needs only fills physical needs (hunger, energy); fun, social and hygiene must still be managed.

FestivalNotificationRework.notification_.text: Sound used for festival notifications. Accepts a simple beep (default), a softer standardised jingle, muted, or the game's normal audio.
FestivalNotificationRework.notification_.type_note: string code - 'beep' is the current value; check the in-game menu for the other literals before writing one

FestivalNotificationRework.relevant_aler.text: Only notify households that are in the festival's world or actively visiting it; teen events only alert households with teens. The main noise reducer.

FestivalNotificationRework.add_sulani_no.text: Gives Sulani festivals the notifications they normally lack, including travel prompts to nearby lots.

FestivalNotificationRework.new_notificat.text: Clearer per-festival icons, mainly for City Living, so you can tell which festival a notification is about at a glance.

FestivalNotificationRework.remove_san_my.text: Removes San Myshuno festival entries from the calendar. Overrides the other filters for that world.

FestivalNotificationRework.remove_mt_kom.text: Removes Mt. Komorebi festival entries from the calendar.

FestivalNotificationRework.remove_henfor.text: Removes Henford-on-Bagley festival entries from the calendar.

FestivalNotificationRework.remove_high_s.text: Removes High School Years event entries from the calendar.

FestivalNotificationRework.remove_ravenw.text: Removes Ravenwood festival entries from the calendar.

FestivalNotificationRework.remove_gibbi_.text: Removes Gibbi Point festival entries from the calendar.

CareerOverhaulSuite.pay_toggle.text: Master switch for the mod's reworked career pay rates. Off restores EA's pay.

CareerOverhaulSuite.pay_multiplier.text: Scales the reworked career pay. 1 = the mod's own rates unscaled; 0.5 halves them, 2 doubles them.

CareerOverhaulSuite.promotion_toggle.text: Master switch for the reworked promotion requirements (the mod's new career goals).

CareerOverhaulSuite.promotion_multiplier.text: Scales how demanding promotion requirements are. 1 = the mod's own values; higher is harder.

CareerOverhaulSuite.freelance_toggle.text: Master switch for reworked freelance/gig pay.

CareerOverhaulSuite.freelance_multiplier.text: Scales freelance gig pay. Currently 0.5, i.e. half the mod's baseline - freelancing is deliberately less lucrative than a career.

CareerOverhaulSuite.fame_toggle.text: Enables the mod's fame-based pay bonuses. Requires Get Famous.

CareerOverhaulSuite.coworker_toggle.text: Generates coworkers for careers, so a job comes with recurring colleagues rather than strangers. Pairs with the GenerateCoworkers addon package.

CareerOverhaulSuite.goodiebag_toggle.text: Enables the mod's promotion reward bundles (the 'goodie bag' handed out on promotion).

CareerOverhaulSuite.negativerep_toggle.text: Allows career performance to inflict negative reputation.

CareerOverhaulSuite.randomrep_toggle.text: Allows random reputation events to fire from career activity.

BasicBurns.tan_rate.text: How fast Sims tan from simply being outdoors, as a multiplier on the base rate. 0.33 is roughly a third speed - a slow, gradual tan.

EnlistInWar.days_spent_at_war.text: How many sim-days a Sim is away once they enlist.

EnlistInWar.death_odds_multiplier.text: Scales the chance a Sim dies at the front. 1 = the mod's baseline odds; 0 would make war survivable, 2 doubles the risk.

LongerLastingNails.nail_duration.text: How long a manicure lasts before it wears off. Stored in SIM-MINUTES: 4320 = 72 hours = 3 sim-days.

NewHobbyTraits.hobby_cooldown_days.text: Days between a hobby trait firing its whim/moodlet effects again.

NewHobbyTraits.worldly_cooldown_days.text: Days between Worldly trait triggers. Set much longer (14) because it keys off travel, which is rarer.

NewSpaDayTraits.healthnut_cooldown_days.text: Days between Health Nut trait triggers. Fractional values are allowed (1.5).

NewEmotionalTraits.test_value.text: Developer scratch value, not a gameplay setting. Nothing to tune here.

HomeRegions.bidirectional_toggle.text: When on, allowing world A's Sims into world B automatically allows B's into A. Off (current) means each direction is set independently, which is more work but more precise.

HomeRegions.save_across_gallery_toggle.text: Carries a Sim's assigned home world with them through the Gallery, so downloaded/uploaded Sims keep their region.

HomeRegions.ShowSuccessNotification.text: Pop-up confirming a Sim was moved or a setting applied.

HomeRegions.ShowSettingsChangedNotificat.text: Pop-up when a Home Regions setting changes.

HomeRegions.ShowWorldExemptionNotificati.text: Pop-up when a per-Sim world exemption is created or removed.

HomeRegions.settings_mode.text: Which settings UI style the mod presents. Cosmetic; change it in-game rather than here.

HomeRegions.experimental.text: Opts into unfinished features. Leave off unless chasing a specific fix.

HomeRegions.disabled_save_guids.text: Saves where the mod is switched off, by GUID. Managed by the mod - do not hand-edit.

HomeRegions.registered_unknown_regions.text: Worlds the mod discovered but has no rules for. Managed by the mod - do not hand-edit.

HomeRegions.street_level_expansions.text: Per-street overrides layered on top of world rules. Managed via the kuttoe.hr.* commands.

HomeRegions.alert_about_occult_homelands.text: Who to warn about occult homeland rules. 'ALL_SIMS' is the broadest setting.

_scaling_about:
One test decides whether a setting scales with lifespan: DOES IT RUN OUT? A finite pursuit - a spellbook, a ladder, a collection - that is tuned to fill a vanilla life will finish in the first tenth of a long one and leave the rest of that life empty. Those scale. Everything else is the texture of play: it repeats forever, the author tuned how it feels in an evening, and a longer lifespan does not make it wrong. Those are left alone, and scaling them up only makes a trait feel dead.
'scale' is up, down, or no. 'down' is for rates expressed as a percentage of normal, where a longer life wants a SMALLER number - the arithmetic inverts, the reasoning does not.
'base' is the MOD DEFAULT, never the current value. Rescaling always recomputes from base, so repeated runs cannot compound.

SpellcasterTweaks.tome_cooldown.why: The spellbook is finite. Unscaled, a spellcaster exhausts it early in a long life and the whole magic arc is over with centuries left to play.

SpellcasterTweaks.teachspell_cooldown.why: Same spellbook, the rarer of its two routes. Kuttoe's learning_changes sets tome and teachspell 15:1 on purpose, so both must move together or that ratio - the actual mechanic - is destroyed.

EnlistInWar.days_spent_at_war.why: A deployment is meant to cost a real piece of a life. Three days out of 560 is not a war, it is an errand.

NewHobbyTraits.hobby_cooldown_days.why: Ambient trait flavour with no end state - it fires forever. Stretching it to 12 days would not preserve anything, it would just make the trait look broken.

NewHobbyTraits.worldly_cooldown_days.why: Same shape as hobby_cooldown_days; the 14 is already long because it keys off travel, not because it is rationed across a lifetime.

NewSpaDayTraits.healthnut_cooldown_days.why: Repeating trait trigger, no end state.

LongerLastingNails.nail_duration.why: How long a manicure lasts. The point of the mod is that it outlasts a play session; nothing about a longer life changes that.

BasicBurns.tan_rate.why: A rate multiplier, not a time span. Nothing to scale.

patterns.text: Venue Filter: whether Home Regions governs who spawns on this lot type, separately from the overall world rules. On = local Sims only; off = the game's normal anyone-anywhere behaviour.

Career/Situation Filter: whether this specific spawned role is restricted to local Sims. Off means the game picks from anywhere, which is usually what you want for rare roles so they don't fail to spawn.
Lets this occult type ignore normal world restrictions so they can appear beyond their home region.
Extra worlds this occult type may appear in, as a list of region codes. Alien defaults to STRANGERVILLE + SCIENCE_LAB, witch to GLIMMERBROOK.
Controls what the region-expansion menus display in-game. Presentation only; no gameplay effect.
Housekeeping for worlds the mod hasn't seen before (usually added by packs or other mods).
In-game UI preference for how Home Regions presents its controls. No gameplay effect.

Per-world rule for this world. Each world carries about five keys covering its Regional Filter (which worlds' Sims may appear here), its Soft Filter strength (prefer locals, then fall back to existing townies elsewhere rather than creating new ones), and related exemptions.
